title: Straight-line simulation of a fan-in-two circuit
statement: Let $n>0$, and suppose a Boolean function on $n$ inputs is computed by a fan-in-two directed acyclic circuit of size at most $S$. Then the function is computed by a valid straight-line program of length at most $2(S-n)+1$.
hypotheses_covered: There exists a fan-in-two circuit on $n$ inputs
